item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"Reject the anchor-repair family: its mutable probation/protected repairs retain conflicting local rationales and cannot establish a single causal policy premise. Freeze a contract-grounded counter-theory of evidence-gated commitment: behavior must derive from stable online evidence about repeated usefulness, while transient scan activity must not acquire equivalent authority. The theory is binding but non-prescriptive about implementation.","witnesses":["The anchor exposes multiple mutable repair authorities: promotion, protected demotion, and eviction order can preserve locally reasonable decisions without a unified causal explanation.","The contract requires online-only operation, legal evictions, and capacity safety, but provides no score evidence permitting claims of measured superiority.","The hypothesized bottleneck is retained causal optionality during construction; coherent behavior therefore requires one premise to govern admission, retention, and adaptation consistently."],"obligations":["Preserve the required Policy interface and standard-library-only, online visibility constraints.","Return only unique integer keys that are currently cached and never exceed the declared byte capacity.","Give repeated, contract-visible usefulness authority over retention decisions while limiting transient scan exposure.","Use one coherent causal premise across admission, retention, eviction, and phase adaptation; do not reintroduce anchor-local reversible repairs.","Do not rely on hidden traces, evaluator state, oracle decisions, benchmark paths, external libraries, networking, or subprocesses.","Treat performance improvement as unproven because scores and trace evidence are withheld."],"exact_actions":["Bind the realization call to the evidence-gated commitment described here.","Reject premise revision, terminal compression, inherited two-stage repair authority, and any alternative counter-theory.","Permit realization only within the stated contract obligations and the frozen causal premise.","Declare the theory falsified if any matched evaluation shows a contract violation, or if valid matched-majority and strict-median evidence fails to support the predicted reduction in scan contamination and improved phase-shift adaptation."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
